prefer original strong checkpoint without new fit

utility_policy.not_technical_exclusion: one or two legitimate calls lost; numerical baseline kernel discrepancy alone
utility_policy.threshold_policy: only strong checkpoint grid; only change from original .5 if strictly improves paired validation utility; no grid for new fit
utility_policy.second_fit: not planned; only if independent technical justification before test
final_comparison: strong adjusted only if improves utility
utility_policy.test_policy: freeze all weights/threshold/config before opening final test/regression this round; no adjustments after
utility_policy.privacy: audio/features/IDs/frame scores/weights private; safe aliases and aggregate metrics only in Git

limitations: All existing test and historical sets were examined previously; exploratory known regressions, not a new blind evaluation.
Historical 15/64 overlap current TRAIN; their results are adjustment diagnostics.
Activation-selected positives measure conditional redetection, not population recall; 1/11 is not a failure-rate estimate.
FP contexts have no continuous exposure denominator; 6/13 is not an FP/hour reduction estimate.
Small correlated sessions and repeated validation constrain generalization.
One lost call costs four FP by engineering preference, not universal scientific equivalence.
Host numeric kernels differ; loading and reset checks do not establish physical ARM64 compatibility.
